entities.summary: Karl Johan Oskar Fabricius is a Swedish former professional ice hockey winger, who most notably played with Luleå HF in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He previously played the 2011–12 season, with HC Lev Poprad, a team located in Poprad, Slovakia of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Late in his career, Fabricius also played for a short time for Heilbronner Falken in the German Second League.
